purpose: Preserve an imported authority corpus exactly before Bootstrap creates or rewrites its replacement.

archive.entry_names: source-relative regular-file paths, sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes
archive.timestamps: zeroed by the deterministic ZIP writer
archive.content: exact source bytes at the read-only preservation boundary

rejection: source root is missing, non-canonical, or outside the admitted import boundary
source contains symbolic links or unsafe filesystem objects
destination is inside the source tree
archive, manifest, index, or receipt readback differs from the source plan
receipt: The receipt binds source content, included and excluded records, archive, manifest, index, output directory, and creation time by SHA-256.
